title: Owl dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- owl dancing -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='26' fill='#b06a2a'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='15' ry='18' fill='#f2c879'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='18' fill='#c47a34'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <polygon points='36,18 32,4 44,14' fill='#a05a1e'/>
  <polygon points='64,18 68,4 56,14' fill='#a05a1e'/>
  <!-- eye discs -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='29' r='9' fill='#f7e9c8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='9' fill='#f7e9c8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='29' r='4.5' fill='#5a2d7a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='4.5' fill='#5a2d7a'/>
  <circle cx='40.5' cy='27.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='27.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points='50,33 45,40 55,40' fill='#ffb020'/>
  <!-- wings raised, dancing -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='48' rx='10' ry='18' transform='rotate(30 22 48)' fill='#a05a1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='48' rx='10' ry='18' transform='rotate(-30 78 48)' fill='#a05a1e'/>
  <!-- wing feather tips -->
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='35' rx='4' ry='7' transform='rotate(30 15 35)' fill='#d89a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='35' rx='4' ry='7' transform='rotate(-30 85 35)' fill='#d89a4a'/>
  <!-- legs, dancing -->
  <path d='M42 86 L38 96 M42 86 L46 96' stroke='#ffb020' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M60 84 L64 96 M60 84 L56 94' stroke='#ffb020' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- little dancing sparkles -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#ffe45e'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#ffe45e'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='20' r='2' fill='#7ae0ff'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='16' r='2' fill='#7ae0ff'/>
</svg>
